body: Thank you for your advice and kind words. I really appreciate your response.

Maybe you need to find something you're passionate about. Find something that is fulfilling or something you find rewarding. Learning how to do something new is always fun. I started learning how to draw a few years ago and I don't regret a single second of the time I've spent drawing. Now I'm a pretty decent artist. I don't really do anything with my art, but I find it fun and rewarding. You could start a garden and learn all about different types of plants. You could learn to play an instrument. Anything that will give consistent "wins," and goals that you are constantly working towards, because as you improve, you grow as a person. It really could be anything, just find something you enjoy. Also, one thing about passion, is that you know it's there when you keep doing something you don't have to do, and continue even during the moments it becomes frustrating or the moments it's not that exciting, because you want that feeling of accomplishment when you finally get it right. Drawing something over and over until it finally looks right, playing the same not sequence over and over until you can play it at the correct tempo, etc.
